project.name: docsile-hms
project.description: Hospital Management System (HMS), multi-tenant SaaS (module-gating + subscription/billing fields already present), expected to grow to <20 hospital tenants by month 18. Handles patient registration, OPD/IPD workflows, billing, pharmacy, labs, optical, insurance, analytics, and call-log integration.

scale.usersMonth6: a few hospitals, tens of staff users per hospital
scale.peakRPS: low (10s, not 100s, per hospital at current scale)
scale.dataGrowthNotes: patient records, prescriptions, and billing history accumulate per hospital indefinitely; no current archival strategy

notes.permissionsDisabled: requireServerPermission() and all hasPermission() checks are deliberately disabled in src/lib/auth.ts and src/lib/permissions.ts — any authenticated user has full access to all server actions.
notes.jwtFallbackSecret: AUTH_SECRET has a hardcoded dev fallback in src/lib/jwt.ts — if env var is missing in prod, all JWTs can be forged.
notes.adminIntegration: src/lib/admin-client.ts returns a static config (all modules enabled, hospital type EYE). The real admin-server integration is temporarily disabled.
notes.supabaseAccess: All server-side DB access uses the SERVICE_ROLE_KEY. No RLS policies enforced. Auth and access control implemented entirely in application code.
notes.noTests: Zero test infrastructure. No jest/vitest/playwright config. Zero test files.
notes.vercelJson: vercel.json contains SPA-style rewrite rules (source: /(.*) -> /index.html) which conflict with Next.js App Router server-side rendering.
